授業概要
本講究では、レーザー光照射などにより電磁波のエネルギーを物質に供与した時の応答の分析、およびこれらの応答を利用した加工、加熱、物質転写（薄膜成膜）プロセスについての研究指導および博士論文執筆指導を行う。
In this seminar, we will provide research guidance and supervision for doctoral dissertations on the analysis of material responses when electromagnetic energy is imparted to them through means such as laser irradiation, as well as on processing, heating, and material transport (thin-film deposition) processes that utilize these responses.
